summary: Split `runFanout`'s merge stage — the ~500-line try from the cherry-pick loop to `clearMergingMarkers` — out of `src/waveTick.ts` into its own module
acceptance: `src/waveTick.ts` holds the wave's provisioning and agent fanout; the merge stage is a named function in its own file, taking the per-entry results and answering the merge outcomes and gate rows. Behavior-free: tsc, the default lane, and the export and citation pins hold it.
notes: Observed by the tick that shipped SIBLING-TICKS-TAKE-TURNS-AT-GIT: after the ship lock landed, the stage is one `try` whose only marker is an indent level (src/waveTick.ts is 1234 lines). No behavior moves — a split that changes an outcome is the wrong split.
